_readme: Hand-labeled sentiment examples for testing Agent 6 (sentiment_agent.py) scorer accuracy. `label` is the expected bucket given score_text()'s [-1,+1] output using the SAME threshold the agent itself uses (see sentiment_agent._stance_from_score: <= -0.15 negative-ish/'confirm', >= 0.15 positive-ish/'contradict', else neutral). `category` marks known-easy vs. known-hard cases for the lexicon scorer so a low overall score doesn't obscure WHERE it's weak.
